  - Install package via pip:

  - After installation, initialize configuration:
    - `metagpt --init-config` (creates `~/.metagpt/config2.yaml` to be modified as needed)

- Configuration:

  - Example configuration parameters:
    ```yaml
    llm:
      api_type: "openai"  # also supports azure / ollama / open_llm etc.
      model: "gpt-4-turbo-preview"  # alternative models available
      base_url: "https://api.openai.com/v1"
      api_key: "YOUR_API_KEY"
    ```

- Dependencies:
  - Main dependency is the `metagpt` Python package (version info not explicitly given)
  - Python version >= 3.9

- Docker Setup:
  - Docker image: `metagpt/metagpt:latest`
  - To download and prepare config:
    ```bash
    docker pull metagpt/metagpt:latest
    mkdir -p /opt/metagpt/{config,workspace}
    docker run --rm metagpt/metagpt:latest cat /app/metagpt/config/config2.yaml > /opt/metagpt/config/config2.yaml
    vim /opt/metagpt/config/config2.yaml  # modify config here
    ```
  - To run container:
    ```bash
    docker run --name metagpt -d \
        --privileged \
        -v /opt/metagpt/config/config2.yaml:/app/metagpt/config/config2.yaml \
        -v /opt/metagpt/workspace:/app/metagpt/workspace \
        metagpt/metagpt:latest
    ```
  - To use inside container:
    ```bash
    docker exec -it metagpt /bin/bash
    metagpt "Create a 2048 game"
    ```
